summary: Lower async-generator yield through a compatibility state machine rather than treating it as a normal C# async iterator yield.

target.notes: Calling the generator creates an async-generator object; body execution is request-driven and each yielded value is delivered through a Promise<IteratorResult>.

semantics.uncaught_throw: reject pending request and close generator

caveats: C# async iterators have different next/return/throw request APIs and disposal/cancellation conventions.
